source.album: The Rolling Stones Rock And Roll Circus

entries.verification: No single of The Who's "A Quick One While He's Away" exists on Deezer, Apple or MusicBrainz, so this is the cover of The Rolling Stones Rock And Roll Circus (ABKCO, 1996, credited to Various Artists), the album Dan's live recording is on.
No single of "Unbroken Chain" exists on Deezer, Apple or MusicBrainz, so this is the cover of From the Mars Hotel (Grateful Dead, 1974), the album the song is on.

The song's own single is Giorgio Moroder with Philip Oakey's "Together in Electric Dreams" (Virgin, 1984); Deezer and Apple only carry album and karaoke versions, so this is the single's sleeve from its MusicBrainz release group.
Deezer's "Sexual Healing" single by Hot 8 Brass Band (Tru Thoughts, 2007) leads with the same "Sexual Healing" recording that is on Rock With the Hot 8; Apple lists the same single.

Deezer's "Sine Dust" by 36 (3six Recordings, 2015) is the four-track EP named after the song and contains it; Dan played it from the companion EP Sine Dust Versions.

entries.song: In The Evening - Extended 12 Inch Version
entries.verification: Deezer's "In The Evening" by Sheryl Lee Ralph is the song's own 1984 single (original extended mix, radio edit, instrumental); Apple lists the same three tracks as "In the Evening - EP" with the same front.

entries.album: So Real: Songs From Jeff Buckley

source.album: So Real: Songs from Jeff Buckley (Expanded Edition)

entries.verification: No single of "I Know It's Over" exists on Deezer, Apple or MusicBrainz, so this is the cover of So Real: Songs from Jeff Buckley (2007), the album that carries this Sony Studios recording; Deezer's Expanded Edition has the same front as Apple's standard edition.

The song's own single is UGK featuring OutKast's "Int'l Players Anthem (I Choose You)" (Jive, 2007); Deezer and Apple only carry album and karaoke versions, so this is the single's sleeve from its MusicBrainz release group.

Dan's track is the title song of Joni Mitchell's 2000 album Both Sides Now, which this is; her streaming singles of the song are other recordings (a 2020 live archive single and the 2021 Clouds remaster), so the album cover is used.

The only single with the song is the 2003 split "Fling Up Your Wig / There's A Better Place", which carries a different mix (Magik Johnson Mix), so this is the cover of The Wicked Is Music (Crazy Penis, Paper Recordings, 1998), the album Dan's version is on.

No single of "My Life in Art" exists on Deezer, Apple or MusicBrainz, so this is the cover of Excuses for Travellers (Mojave 3, 4AD, 2000), the album it is on; Apple's 2000 edition has the same front.
Deezer's "Only One" single by Kanye West (with Paul McCartney) is the one-track 2014 single release of the song; MusicBrainz and Apple date it 31 December 2014.
"Wat's Wrong" (with Zacari and Kendrick Lamar) was never issued as a single on Deezer, Apple or MusicBrainz, so this is the cover of The Sun's Tirade (Isaiah Rashad, 2016), the album it is on.
"Maud Gone" has no single release on Deezer, Apple or MusicBrainz, so this is the cover of Teens of Style (Car Seat Headrest, Matador, 2015), the album it is on.
"To Be Of Use" has no single release on Deezer, Apple or MusicBrainz, so this is the cover of Red Apple Falls (Smog, Drag City, 1997), the album it is on.
